name: StorageFix
subtitle: Review files. Reclaim clarity.
promotionalText: Understand your folders before making changes. Find duplicate copies, review large files, explore storage and export a clear report—all locally on your Mac.
description:
Make room with a clearer picture of your files.

StorageFix helps you review folders you choose, understand where space is going, and decide what to keep. Scans never delete anything.

REVIEW YOUR FOLDERS
Quick Review inventories files and compares duplicate contents in your selected folder. Open a dated report with each scan’s scope, counts, sizes and any errors. Export a text snapshot to a location you choose.

COMPARE DUPLICATE COPIES
Compare file paths, choose the copy to keep, and explicitly select extra copies for Trash. Changed files require a fresh review before removal.

FIND LARGE AND OLD FILES
Filter by file size, type, name, path and last-modified date. Selections remain explicit when you change filters, and the confirmation sheet lists every selected file.

EXPLORE YOUR STORAGE
Use a folder chart and ranked list to explore your scanned inventory. Drill into folders and navigate back without rescanning.

KEEP CONTROL
The Mac App Store edition accesses folders you choose. Access lasts for the session; choose again after relaunch. File removal requires review and moves selected files to Finder Trash. Space is freed when you empty Trash yourself.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, tracking, analytics or file uploads. Scan data stays on your Mac. Recent activity and checklist preferences are stored locally and can be cleared in the app.

Also includes a read-only application inventory and a personal checklist linking to macOS settings. The checklist does not inspect security configuration or detect malware.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. This edition does not clean system caches or uninstall applications. Inventory sizes are logical file sizes; overlapping inventories are not a combined estimate of recoverable space.
whatsNew: A clearer Quick Review dashboard, dated review reports with text export, more readable scan notices, stable file counts and expandable recent activity.
